name: Mainframe outage
description: The mainframe with CICS, DBMS and message queuing fails. Home & Away policies, claims records and the CRM run on it.
mitigation: Fail over to the recovery site; test the runbook twice a year; reduce the mainframe footprint through the consolidation programme.

name: Loss of the head office data centre
description: The head office data centre is unavailable. All in-house applications need a site failover to the recovery site.
mitigation: Annual full-site failover test; recovery order by tier; contract terms with the recovery site provider.

name: Loss of the BIBIT payment network
description: The payment network is unavailable, so premiums cannot be collected and claims cannot be paid electronically.
mitigation: Second payment route through the customer's bank; manual payment fallback for urgent claims.

name: Unix server farm failure
description: The Unix server farm fails. The web portal, call centre, rating, the car and legal aid systems and the financial application run on it.
mitigation: Clustered servers; tested failover to the recovery site; move suitable workloads to cloud.

name: Retire Car Policy Administration
description: Car policies move to the Home & Away platform and the legacy car system is retired.
mitigation: Migrate in product waves; run in parallel for one renewal cycle; keep a read-only archive.

name: Mainframe vendor price rise
description: The mainframe vendor raises licence and support prices by 15 per cent at renewal.
mitigation: Benchmark; reduce MIPS through the consolidation programme; negotiate a multi-year cap.

name: Solvency II review
description: Mandatory. Amended Solvency II rules apply from 30 January 2027.
mitigation: Programme under the Chief Risk Officer; vendor roadmaps for actuarial and reporting tools.

name: EU AI Act high-risk obligations
description: AI used in pricing and fraud must meet AI Act obligations by the application date.
mitigation: AI inventory first, then risk management and human oversight for high-risk uses.

name: DORA remediation
description: DORA already applies. Close the remaining gaps in testing, third-party contracts and recovery.
mitigation: Remediation plan under the IT resilience and DR manager, reported to the Board.
